title: Hisense
summary: A carousel of cans for a summer drink launch: one film, forty cutdowns, one string that holds it together.
body: We built the whole launch around a single motion idea, cans hanging from a string and rotating one slot at a time. The master film shipped with forty cutdowns for social, retail screens and out of home.

title: Creative ideas
summary: A seedling in a circle: an identity for a studio that grows ideas from the ground up.
body: The mark is a circle holding a young plant, the wordmark is set in a heavy serif that feels planted rather than placed. The identity system flexes from a stamp to a full-screen film.

title: To leap
summary: Runners caught mid-leap inside circles, for a city running club that wants to do the firsts.
body: Three circles, three runners, one line of copy: smash the records. The campaign ran on posters, a scroll-driven site and a live leaderboard.

title: The eye
summary: Our own front door: a goat eye that grows into the screen as you scroll.
body: The home page is one long scroll that plays like a film. Every move is keyed to the second of a reference animation, and every picture inside a circle is a frame sequence served from our own backend.

title: Sell that better
summary: A marketplace launch page with a marquee that never stops selling.
body: A loud marquee, a quiet checkout. We cut the funnel down to three steps and let the typography carry the brand.
